| `content`   | `union`                               |          | `\{\}`  | The widget's persisted configuration blob. - `scope` — whose relationship to list: `assigned` (default), `pooled`, `watched` or `all`. Whose INBOX it is stays the endpoint's decision; scope never names another user. - `limit` — rows to request AND show (1–50, default 6). The count line always states the server total regardless of this cap. - `pollSeconds` — refetch interval (default 30; `0` disables). - `rowRoute` — vue-router route NAME to open on a row click, receiving the task uuid as `:id`. Omitted = the click opens the task's openregister deep link instead. - `emptyText` — override for the empty-inbox line. - `variant` — `list` draws a checkbox list: a checkbox that completes the viewer's own task, the title, the subject on a second muted line and the due date at its right.
